news.summary: Management presented and held investor meetings at Baird's conference in New York on September 15.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $94.5M (+19% YoY) with U.S. procedures above 13,100 (about +21%) and 65 U.S. HYDROS systems delivered. Gross margin rose to 66% and full-year revenue guidance of $390-410M was reiterated; WATER IV prostate cancer enrollment was completed.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Third-party estimate, not yet confirmed by the company; key test for system placements and procedure growth versus the $390-410M full-year guide.

pulse: PROCEPT's Q2 2026 revenue grew 19% to $94.5M with gross margin expanding to 66%, and full-year guidance of $390-410M was reiterated. Aquablation gained a strengthened recommendation in updated AUA guidelines and WATER IV enrollment is complete. Operating expenses are rising as the company invests in commercial build-out and the prostate cancer trial.
